lab5.aim: Package an application in a custom Docker image and build and run it
lab5.requirements: Docker Engine and the supplied ShopEasy Lite source
lab5.description: The Dockerfile validates and packages the app in one stage, then copies the runtime files into a non-root Node.js 24 Alpine stage. Port 3000 serves the shop and /health reports its version.
lab5.execution: Docker execution is handled separately by the Docker lab runner

lab6.aim: Lint, test on two Node.js versions and package on every push and pull request, with required checks protecting main
lab6.requirements: GitHub repository, Actions enabled and administration rights for branch protection
lab6.description: The CI workflow has Node.js 22 and 24 matrix jobs, read-only contents permission, pinned actions and separate packaged artifacts. Branch protection must require both matrix checks and prevent bypasses.
lab6.observed: Local Node.js 24 validation passed seven tests. Workflow files were prepared; this task did not execute hosted Actions or configure branch protection.

lab7.aim: Publish a versioned image to GHCR, pull and run that exact image and roll back to an earlier version
lab7.requirements: Docker Engine, GitHub Actions package publishing permission, GHCR access and two published image digests
lab7.description: The publication workflow builds and validates an image on main changes and semantic version tags, authenticates with GITHUB_TOKEN and records a digest reference for exact deployment and rollback.
lab7.observed: The release workflow and digest-based deployment commands were prepared. This task did not publish to GHCR or perform a registry pull.
